authorization: 사용자가 눈 클로즈업→낮은 시점 준비→뒤 거대한 호랑이 형상→화면 가르기→전투 명중 흐름의 별도 컷씬 제작 요청. 기존 컷씬 분류·무음·PixelLab 규칙 유지.

newPixelLabAssets.authorization: 사용자가 기존 암중호격과 별도로 눈 클로즈업 → 낮은 시점 준비 → 뒤 거대한 호랑이 형상 → 화면 가르는 공격 → 실제 전투 명중 컷씬 추가를 승인. 기존 무음 유지. 담당 에이전트는 신규 도트 전용 그림 최대2개 범위.

reuseInspection.fullStrikeFrameReview: 00..12 전체를 원본 순서 컨택트시트로 다시 열어 확인. 기존 모션의 실제 브라우저 재생 검증을 새로 수행한 것은 아님.
reuseInspection.decision: 기존 portrait는 눈 클로즈업, strike/13장은 공격 컷에 재사용 가능.1..6은 주먹을 가슴으로 당기지만 하체가 잘려 발을 고정한 준비를 읽기 어려움. 기존 tiger-spirit는 머리만 있어 뒤의 거대한 몸 형상이 필요한 새 컷씬을 위해 전용 준비자세와 호랑이 상반신2종 생성.

request.description: ONE cinematic pixel-art FULL BODY key pose of Ataho, the SAME stocky older male anthropomorphic orange tiger martial artist in the reference images. LOW CAMERA ANGLE from a victim looking UP toward him, front three-quarter view. This is a still BEFORE striking: he has sunk his weight low into a wide deep stance with both knees bent, the nearer bare tiger foot firmly planted toward the viewer, entire foot and heel visible. His torso coils, his right CLOSED FIST is pulled tight BACK against his OWN WAIST/RIBS in preparation, his other closed fist stays close to the opposite hip. BOTH hands remain beside his torso, absolutely NO fist extended toward camera, no throwing punch yet, no hand in the foreground. His heavy cream-shirt-covered belly, low hips and wide grounded stance convey stored strength. Head angled slightly down to look at the victim with focused half-lidded golden eyes and a quiet knowing smirk. Orange fur, dark stripes, broad cream muzzle and cheek tufts, round ears, short mildly gray brows, seasoned older face. Preserve the SAME RED-BROWN long-sleeve open jacket, ivory wrap shirt, brown knotted sash, loose charcoal trousers, bare striped tiger hands and feet, and ONE orange striped tail curving to the side. Crisp detailed arcade fighting-game pixel art matching the reference cutscene style, visible angular square pixel clusters, dark outlines, restrained warm shading and subtle golden rim light. Full head, both feet, hands and tail must fit completely inside 256x256 with eight pixel transparent margin. Single character, no duplicates, no opponent, no scenery, no floor, no aura, no shadow disk, no text. Genuinely transparent surrounding canvas.

reference_images.usage: EXACT Ataho identity, face, stocky body, clothing and pixel art style. Change pose entirely to a deep grounded windup; do NOT copy extended foreground fist.
Exact base character proportions, cream inner shirt, brown jacket, bare feet and stripe identity; make full body visible.
Same Ataho profile, tail and clothes only.

generations.review: 양발·발뒤꿈치가 보이는 전신과 넓은 무릎 굽힌 준비자세. 양주먹이 허리 옆에 모이며 전경으로 뻗지 않음. 갈색 재킷·크림 속옷·주황 털·꼬리1개 확인. 요청한 매우 낮은 피격자 시점은 약하게 표현되므로 런타임 프레이밍과 함께 사용자 리뷰 필요. 기존 portrait보다 회색 노년상 표현이 덜함.

request.description: ONE huge roaring SPECTRAL TIGER apparition, a real four-legged tiger's HEAD, SHOULDERS, CHEST AND BOTH FRONT PAWS seen from the FRONT at a slightly low angle, not a human. The whole apparition is formed from bright amber-gold firelike INK and deep near-black tiger stripes, matching a classic arcade fighting-game golden tiger spirit. Broad fierce tiger face with rounded ears, long cheek tufts, open roaring mouth and white-gold fangs; heavy feline shoulders and both natural tiger forelegs extend down on either side of the chest, with clearly animal paws and claws. The lower chest and foreleg tips dissolve into flowing angular gold ink flames, so this is an upper-body spectral manifestation for a martial arts cinematic. Distinct readable silhouette with a towering head above the shoulders; do not reduce this to a floating head alone. Warm orange-gold and cream-gold highlights with deep black negative-space stripe shapes, orange ember edges. Fine dark pixel outlines, highly expressive detailed arcade pixel art, crisp visible square pixel clusters, angular stepped flame tips, no blur, restrained shading. Entire ears, head, shoulders and paws fit within the 256x256 square with clear transparent margin. Single creature, no person, no humanoid body, no clothing, no weapon, no scroll, no decorative circle, no background, no floor, no text, no writing, no symbols. Genuinely transparent background.

generations.review: 정면 포효하는 호랑이 머리·넓은 어깨·가슴·양 앞발이 이어지는 금빛/먹빛 상반신 형상. 가슴 아래가 불꽃으로 사라지고 인물·문자·배경 없음. 아타호 뒤에서 별개 거대 형상으로 배치할 정적 그림이며 호랑이의 실제 포효 애니메이션을 생성한 것은 아님.
